about.title: MCP security testing: E3 and E6 with mcp-audit and vulnerable servers

experiments.E3: Tool poisoning / rug pull -- a benign request against a maliciously-described tool.
experiments.E6: Context exposure -- cross-workspace over-sharing through memory and filesystem servers.

about.what_is_here: Two live OpenCode campaigns (runtime traffic captured by the logging proxy) plus APIsec mcp-audit's static results on the lab configs and on the team's shortlisted real MCP servers pinned to their vulnerable versions.
about.environment: Everything is synthetic and local. Canary secrets (CANARY-A-7f3c9; WORKSPACE_B_SECRET-4471), a local sink that performs no network egress, denied out-of-root reads. The real CVE servers were only statically scanned, never run.
